review.finding: The fix for a previously-reported finding (AuditLogModal's queryFn side effect duplicating rows on background refetch) added refetchOnMount:false/refetchOnReconnect:false/refetchOnWindowFocus:false, but this also disabled the FOREGROUND refetch TanStack Query would do on a genuine remount with cached data. Since LeadCard.tsx conditionally unmounts AuditLogModal on close ({auditOpen && <AuditLogModal .../>}), reopening the same lead's audit log within the default 5-minute gcTime remounts the component with local `pages` state reset to [] while the cached query never re-invokes queryFn (so the side effect that populated `pages` never fires) -- the modal renders a completely blank body with no loading/error/not-found state. 100% reproducible on every close-then-reopen cycle.
review.suggestion: Stop deriving entries from a queryFn side effect. Fetch each page via its own query (e.g. useQueries keyed per cursor) and derive entries directly from each query's data, so a cache hit on remount renders immediately with no side effect required. Add a regression test: open, close (unmount), reopen with the same QueryClient, assert entries are still visible.
